name: folha-bone-q2
prompt: This image is a character model sheet: one cartoon mascot drawn in six poses in a 3 x 2 grid. Create the SECOND ANIMATION FRAME of the whole sheet. Keep EVERYTHING exactly as it is: same character, same cap, same outfit, same pose, same position and same scale inside each cell, same line weight, same flat light gray fill (#C8C8C8), same pure black lines, same pure white background, no shading, no new elements, no text. Change ONLY these small details, one per cell: cell 1 (top-left, OK sign): his eyes are closed in a happy blink (two short curved lines), everything else identical. cell 2 (top-middle, clipboard): the pencil tip is lower on the clipboard, as if in the middle of writing the next line; his hand moved down with it. cell 3 (top-right, magnifying glass): the magnifying glass is tilted slightly and a little lower, his eye still looking through it. cell 4 (bottom-left, raised hand): the raised open hand is tilted the other way, as if waving, and the exclamation mark is slightly higher. cell 5 (bottom-middle, knocked out): the three little stars have rotated to different positions around his head. cell 6 (bottom-right, asleep): his head has drooped a little lower toward his chest and the Z letters have floated a bit higher.
